metric_definitions.definition: Mean cosine between the two held-out pair endpoints before steering.

metric_definitions.definition: Population SD across held-out pair-level baseline endpoint cosines.

metric_definitions.definition: Mean cosine of z0 + alpha*d to its paired positive endpoint z1.

metric_definitions.aggregation: mean across concepts within seed, then three seeds
metric_definitions.definition: Population SD across pair-level positive-steering endpoint cosines.

metric_definitions.aggregation: mean across concepts within seed, then three seeds

metric_definitions.aggregation: concepts within seed, then three seeds
metric_definitions.definition: Positive-steering endpoint cosine minus the same-origin baseline.

metric_definitions.aggregation: concepts within seed, then three seeds
metric_definitions.definition: Same-origin baseline minus negative-steering endpoint cosine.

metric_definitions.definition: Positive-steering cosine minus negative-steering cosine for the same origin and target.

metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of held-out pairs whose negative-steering cosine falls below baseline.

metric_definitions.aggregation: concepts within seed, then three seeds
metric_definitions.definition: Fraction of held-out pairs satisfying positive > baseline > negative cosine.

protocol.direction_selection: within each persisted concept label, choose the decoder column and sign with maximum absolute cosine to the cfc_train mean delta
protocol.directionality_criterion: positive cosine > baseline cosine > negative cosine
protocol.negative_intervention: z0 - calibrated vector, scored against z1
protocol.origin: z0 for baseline, positive, and negative conditions
protocol.positive_intervention: z0 + calibrated vector, scored against z1
protocol.random_control: 100 isotropic Gaussian directions independently matched to each learned calibrated-vector norm
protocol.target: paired z1 for baseline, positive, and negative conditions

uncertainty: population standard deviation across three concept-balanced seed means; reported in tables, intentionally omitted from the ray figure
